title: Curated MCP tool intents
description: features/<stack>/mcp/<server>/tools.json — hand-written intent and tags per tool, for a host that shows the model tool NAMES with no descriptions once definitions are deferred (ADR-0014 §1). Distinct from schemas/mcp-tools.schema.json, which is the per-project generated index this catalog seeds.

server.description: The owning server's name, matching its meta.json.

tools.description: Curated tools only. Absence is not a claim that a tool does not exist.

name.description: The tool name as the host exposes it, without the mcp__<server>__ prefix.

intent.description: When to reach for this tool — the thing a model cannot derive from the name alone. The generated index copies this verbatim, so it is bound by that schema's own 200-character limit.

tags.description: Tags from the closed vocabulary in features/common/mcp-tags.json. Grouping and display vocabulary, never a matching key on their own (ADR-0012).
